notes.title: Update notice (Ver.1.2.0.2)
notes.content:
■Update details

The issue below has been corrected.

 - If Virtual Mode was being used, the game would sometimes stop during events related to child raising.

notes.title: Update notice (Ver.1.2.0.1)
notes.content:
■Update details
The issue below has been handled.

 - When gold was awarded to a governor for completing a city goal, 
the value for gold was incorrect for the city of the district commander who awarded the gold.
 - Corrected an issue in which the conditions for achieving the best endings for Warlords and District Captains were incorrect.
